outputs.explanation: Panel A shows time-lapse phase contrast images of a representative cell for mock-treated and saccharin-treated conditions. This is a microscopy experiment that implies underlying biological replication (the experiment was presumably repeated), but the caption gives no statement of how many times the experiment/time-lapse was performed or what kind of replicate (e.g., independent experiments, biological replicates) the shown image represents.

Panel B shows phase contrast and fluorescence images (BF, eCFP-FtsZ, NAO) at several time points following saccharin treatment. No statement is given in the caption about the number of times this experiment was performed or the type of replicate (e.g., biological/independent experiments) that the displayed images represent.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
